units.source_text: 但是，她那玲珑而悬直的鼻梁轮廓模糊，小巧的芳唇也失去了色泽。

en.t: But the outline of her delicate, straight nose had grown indistinct, and her small fragrant lips had lost their color.

units.source_text: 岛村无法相信成弧状横跨太空的明亮的光带竟会如此昏暗。

en.t: Shimamura could not believe that the bright band of light arcing across the sky could be so dim.

units.source_text: 大概是星光比朦胧的月夜更加暗淡的缘故吧。

en.t: Perhaps it was because starlight was even fainter than a hazy moonlit night.

units.source_text: 可是，银河比任何满月的夜空都要澄澈明亮。

en.t: And yet the Milky Way was clearer and brighter than any sky under a full moon.
There were hardly any shadows on the ground.

units.source_text: 奇怪的是，驹子的脸活像一副旧面具，淡淡地浮现出来，散发出一股女人的芳香。

en.t: Strangely, Komako's face emerged faintly like an old mask, giving off the fragrance of a woman.
